summary: Added docshelf/access.py with the documented names and rules, and moved every access check of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit into it, each with its own module-level RULES; store.py, render.py and errors.py are unchanged. The existing tests and the new tests/test_access.py pass, and 24000 random commands gave identical output, exit status and workspace files compared with the original package. Quirks kept as they were: the commands disagree on suspension day, role case and spaces, until-minute handling, blank teams, `*` grants and delegation scope, and `edit` honors `*` grants from any granter.
